research_question: When the source fact and its correction fall outside a bounded recent-context window, does UruhaBrain preserve the current user state without reviving stale or relationally misbound values, and how does that compare with the same local LLM given either recent context or the full transcript?
memory_subject: the user's current favorite drink while reading papers

evidence_boundary.replayed_turns: All non-checkpoint turns are a frozen transcript written through production save_episode into an isolated database; they are not fresh generations.
evidence_boundary.system_checkpoints: Turns 25, 26, 48, 49, and 50 run the full UruhaBrain runtime with RightBrain model loading disabled, matching the bounded V2.17 runtime setup.
evidence_boundary.plain_llm_conditions: The same qwen2.5:7b local backbone receives the same persona/output contract. plain_recent receives only the previous eight dialogue turns; plain_full receives the complete prior transcript.
evidence_boundary.claim_limit: This is one preregistered scaling case using the same preference-revision task family as V2.17, not an independent semantic holdout and not human preference evidence.
